## model for restaurant
```{r include=FALSE}
## restaurant all generate data
restaurant_2019all <- subset(data2019, BIZ == "restaurant")
lm_restaurant_2019all <- lm(EXPENDITURE ~ mobility + MONTH, data = restaurant_2019all)
restaurant_2020all <- subset(data2020, BIZ == "restaurant")
lm_restaurant_2020all <- lm(EXPENDITURE ~ mobility + MONTH, data = restaurant_2020all)
restaurant_2021all <- subset(data2021, BIZ == "restaurant")
lm_restaurant_2021all <- lm(EXPENDITURE ~ mobility + MONTH, data = restaurant_2021all)
restaurant_2022all <- subset(data2022, BIZ == "restaurant")
lm_restaurant_2022all <- lm(EXPENDITURE ~ mobility + MONTH, data = restaurant_2022all)
restaurant_all <- subset(USDdata, BIZ == "restaurant")
# 创建一个新的数据框，用于收集所有的预测
predictions <- data.frame()
# 对每个模型进行预测，已经有了自变量的范围数据
for(year in 2019:2022) {
  # 获取当前模型和数据
  model <- get(paste0("lm_restaurant_", year, "all"))
  data <- get(paste0("restaurant_", year, "all"))
  
  # 创建新数据，用于预测
  # 使用数据最大最小mobility
  new_data <- expand.grid(
    mobility = seq(from = min(restaurant_all$mobility), to = max(restaurant_all$mobility), length.out = 100),
    MONTH = c("01")
  )
  
  # 生成预测
  new_data$Prediction <- predict(model, newdata = new_data)
  new_data$Year <- as.factor(year)
  
  # 将新的预测数据添加到总的数据框中
  predictions <- rbind(predictions, new_data)
}
```

## No use: figure S3 data process
```{r echo=FALSE}
yearly_sums <- list()

# 循环处理2019年到2022年的数据
for(year in 2019:2022) {
  yearly_data <- USDdata %>%
    filter(YEAR == year, BIZ == "restaurant") %>%
    group_by(DIST) %>%
    summarise(`sumexp` = sum(EXPENDITURE, na.rm = TRUE)) 
  
  # 为汇总列直接添加年份后缀，不使用rename
  colname <- paste0(year, "sumexp")
  names(yearly_data)[2] <- colname
  
  # 将每年的结果存储在list中
  yearly_sums[[as.character(year)]] <- yearly_data
}

# 得到2019-2022 sum exp
sumexp_restaurant <- reduce(yearly_sums, full_join, by = "DIST")

# 初始化一个空的数据框架来存储所有年份的结果
all_years_coefficients <- list()

# 遍历2019年到2022年
for(year in 2019:2022) {
  # 筛选出当前年份的餐厅数据
  data_year_restaurant <- subset(USDdata, BIZ == "restaurant" & YEAR == as.character(year))
  # 初始化当前年份的结果数据框
  coefficients_restaurant_year <- data.frame(DIST = character(), slope = numeric(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  unique_dists <- unique(data_year_restaurant$DIST)
  for(dist in unique_dists) {
    # Subset data for the current DIST
    subset_data <- data_year_restaurant[data_year_restaurant$DIST == dist, ]
    
    # 标准化expenditure和mobility
    subset_data$EXPENDITURE <- scale(subset_data$EXPENDITURE)
    subset_data$mobility <- scale(subset_data$mobility)
    
    # Build the linear model with standardized variables
    model <- lm(EXPENDITURE ~ mobility + YEARMONTH, data = subset_data) 
    
    # Extract the slope coefficient for 'mobility'
    slope <- coef(model)["mobility"]
    
    # Append the DIST and corresponding slope to the results dataframe
    coefficients_restaurant_year <- rbind(coefficients_restaurant_year, data.frame(DIST = dist, slope = slope))
  }
  
  # 将当前年份的结果存储在列表中
  all_years_coefficients[[as.character(year)]] <- coefficients_restaurant_year
}



# 首先为每个数据框的斜率列添加年份后缀
names_list <- c("2019", "2020", "2021", "2022") # 年份列表
for(year in names_list) {
  # 修改斜率列的名称，添加年份后缀
  names(all_years_coefficients[[year]])[2] <- paste0("slope", year)
}

# 使用Reduce和merge按DIST合并所有数据框
coefficients_restaurant <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "DIST", all = TRUE), all_years_coefficients)

# 内连接
restaurant_slope_characteristic <- coefficients_restaurant %>%
  left_join(sumexp_restaurant, by = "DIST") %>%
  left_join(district_info, by = "DIST")

long_df_restaurant <- pivot_longer(restaurant_slope_characteristic,
                                   cols = starts_with("slope"),
                                   names_to = "Year",
                                   values_to = "Slope")
```

## figure S3
```{r echo=FALSE}
restaurant_slope_characteristic <- coefficients_restaurant %>%
  left_join(sumexp_restaurant, by = "DIST") %>%
  left_join(district_info, by = "DIST")
data_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(restaurant_slope_characteristic, cols = starts_with("slope"),
                                 names_to = "Year", values_to = "Slope")

# 将年份转换为一个因子，以便在图例中以不同颜色显示

data_long$Year <- substr(data_long$Year, 6, nchar(data_long$Year))
data_long$Year <- factor(data_long$Year, levels = c("2019", "2020", "2021", "2022"))
# 绘制散点图
figure_S3 <- ggplot(data_long, aes(x = Daytime_pop_percent, y = Slope, color = Year, shape = as.factor(DIST))) +
  geom_point(size = 5) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = 1:25) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Daytime population index", y = "Elasticity of restaurant", color = "Year", shape = "District") + # 自定义标签
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), # 默认字体大小和样式
    axis.title = element_text(size = 25, face = "bold"), # 轴标题
    axis.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), # 轴文本
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), # 图例标题
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), # 图例文本
    plot.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"), # 图标题
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold") # 分面标签文本
  )
print(figure_S3)
```
